clips.title: The story
paras: Render's Rock is a cavern stronghold tucked into the northwestern crags of the Redridge Mountains, sitting near the high pass leading toward the Burning Steppes. Controlled by the fierce Blackrock orcs, it serves as a forward redoubt and an active staging ground for their raids on the valleys below.

Carved into the rugged heights north of Lakeshire, Render's Rock serves as a fortified cave system for the invading Blackrock clan. From this defensible redoubt near the mountain pass to the Burning Steppes, veteran Blackrock orcs orchestrate attacks against the local defenders of Redridge. Its shadowed depths are strictly guarded, making any foray inside a perilous undertaking for those seeking to disrupt the orcish supply lines or recover captives lost in the ongoing conflict.
